title: NIST IR 8259A: IoT Device Cybersecurity Capability Core Baseline

capabilities.description: Each IoT device must possess a unique, verifiable identity (e.g. IEEE 802.1AR DevID, immutable MAC address) to prevent spoofing, MAC cloning, and rogue device impersonation.
Disable legacy protocols (Telnet, unencrypted HTTP, cleartext SNMP) to eliminate trivial attack vectors and prevent IoT nodes from being recruited into Mirai-like botnet swarms.
Restrict open listening sockets to authorized management ports and isolate IoT data transport to encrypted channels (TLS 1.3, DTLS, MQTT over TLS).
